question: Which opposing karmic outcomes are declared irrelevant to the liberated yogin?
premises: Sins such as brahmin-killing are mentioned
Merits such as horse-sacrifice are mentioned
Both are presented as karmic fruits
inference: Both grave sins and great ritual merits are set out as karmic outcomes.
uncertainties: Their irrelevance is completed in the next verse
plain_english: Sin such as brahmin-killing and merit such as the horse sacrifice.
